goals.title: Ship library hold / waitlist desk
goals.body: Build a library hold desk from vague stakeholder requirements. Patrons place holds on titles; desk staff fulfill; public page shows waitlist/availability. Support titles+copies, hold lifecycle (request/cancel/fulfill), roles (patron, desk staff, admin), REST API, desk UI, public waitlist page, audit log. Stack is agent choice.

tasks.title: Design architecture and data model
tasks.body: Choose stack. Design schema: titles, copies, users/roles, holds, waitlist position, audit. Define REST API. Produce SPEC.md and PLANNING-MATRIX.md before implementation.

tasks.title: Implement REST API and auth
tasks.body: Backend: login/session, title/copy CRUD, hold request/cancel/fulfill, role-based access. Tests for all routes.

tasks.title: Implement desk staff UI
tasks.body: Browser UI for desk staff and admins: holds queue, fulfill/cancel, filters, audit visible.

tasks.title: Implement public waitlist / availability page
tasks.body: Read-only page showing title availability and waitlist depth. No visitor login.

tasks.title: End-to-end verification
tasks.body: Full test suite. Manual verify hold lifecycle, roles, public page, audit. Document VERIFY.md.

assumptions.title: Public page is read-only
assumptions.body: Visitors see availability / waitlist depth only — no writes.
